question: Choose the correct meaning of the idiom: The Midas touch

options.text: The ability to turn anything into gold

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. The ability to turn anything into gold.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"The Midas touch"** refers to the ability to succeed or make a profit in everything one undertakes. (हर काम में सफलता पाने की क्षमता)
 
 
• **Example:** Rohan has the Midas touch when it comes to investments; every stock he buys turns out to be a winner.
 
 
• In this idiom, the word "Midas" originates from Greek mythology, where King Midas was granted the power to turn everything he touched into gold. (ग्रीक पौराणिक कथाओं से लिया गया है, जहाँ राजा मिडास को यह शक्ति मिली थी कि वह छूने से हर चीज़ को सोने में बदल सकता था।)

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. The ability to turn anything into gold.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: Financial hardship** (वित्तीय कठिनाई) - Refers to a situation of economic or monetary struggle.
 
 
• **Example:** Many people faced financial hardship during the pandemic.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: A bad reputation** (खराब प्रतिष्ठा) - Refers to having a negative or dishonorable image in society.
 
 
• **Example:** The company gained a bad reputation after multiple customer complaints.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: A lucky streak** (भाग्यशाली दौर) - Refers to a period of continuous success or good fortune.
 
 
• **Example:** She’s been on a lucky streak, winning three competitions in a row.
